customSections.label: HSD Uses a Two-Day Opening Schedule
customSections.content: HSD does not start every grade on the same day. Grades 1–6, 7, and 9 begin September 1, while kindergarten, grade 8, and grades 10–12 begin September 2. August 26 is Family Connections and Transitions, not the first regular day of classes.

customSections.label: HSD 2026–27 Grading Period End Dates
customSections.content: Quarter and semester end dates are regular school days in HSD. When students are off the following day for grading or staff work, that date is listed separately in the calendar above.

customSections.label: November No-School Days and June Make-Up Dates
customSections.content: Two parts of HSD's calendar are easy to misread: the stretch of no-school days around Thanksgiving and the possible make-up days after the scheduled last day of school.

groups.label: November no-school dates
items: Students do not attend November 20 and November 23–27. The dates cover grading and workdays, staff development and conference preparation, Family Conference Connections, Thanksgiving, and a licensed non-contract day. Students return Monday, November 30.

groups.label: Scheduled last day of school
items: June 10 is the scheduled last day for grades K–11, with early release. June 11 is the last day for licensed staff and is not a student attendance day.

groups.label: Possible make-up days
items: June 14–15 become school days only if HSD adds them to the calendar after an inclement-weather closure. HSD states that graduation dates would not be affected.

whatsNew.title: What Changed From 2025–26
content: Grades 1–6, 7, and 9 start September 1, two days earlier than last year's September 3 start. The all-student opening is September 2 instead of September 4.
Family Conference Connections are November 24–25 this year, one day earlier than the November 25–26 dates in 2025–26.
The scheduled K–11 last day is June 10, one day earlier than last year. Possible weather make-up days are June 14–15 instead of June 15–16.
HSD still schedules 173 student days, but Semester 1 increases from 87 to 88 days while Semester 2 decreases from 86 to 85.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Hillsboro School District start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades 1–6, 7, and 9 start Tuesday, September 1, 2026. Kindergarten, grade 8, and grades 10–12 start Wednesday, September 2.

calendarFaqs.q: When are Hillsboro students off for Thanksgiving in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Students do not attend November 20 and November 23–27 for a combination of grading, staff development, Family Conference Connections, Thanksgiving, and a licensed non-contract day. Students return Monday, November 30.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Hillsboro School District Winter Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 21–31, 2026, with January 1 also marked as no school. Students return Monday, January 4, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Hillsboro School District Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs March 22–26, 2027. Students return Monday, March 29.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school in Hillsboro School District in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: June 10, 2027, is the scheduled last day for grades K–11, with early release. HSD may add June 14–15 as school days after an inclement-weather closure. HSD states that graduation dates would not be affected.

sourceReviewSummary: Last checked August 9, 2026. We verified the dates on this page against HSD's board-adopted 2026–27 district calendar and the district calendar page.
sourceReviewDetails: We reviewed HSD's official one-page PDF visually because the calendar uses color to distinguish first days, grading-period endings, early-release days, no-school days, and Family Connections and Transitions.
We cross-checked the dates and labels against HSD's calendar page and board-adopted PDF. We also verified the PDF's semester totals: 88 student days in Semester 1 and 85 in Semester 2.
We recheck the page if HSD publishes a revision or announces that a June make-up day will be used.
